name: Nelson's Farm Market
description: Nelson's Farm Market grows Strawberries, Raspberries, Apples, Pears, and Peaches in Grant, MI. The farm is independent, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
